# PingOne Standards

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Enterprise Standards](../../README.md) • [Technology Standards](../README.md)**

---

> This directory contains PingOne specific standards for enterprise environments. These standards provide comprehensive guidance for identity and access management implementation, resource naming conventions, configuration management, security policies, and multi-tenant architectures using the PingOne platform.

These standards ensure consistent, secure, and scalable PingOne implementations across the platform. They complement the general security standards with PingOne-specific guidance for:

- Resource naming conventions and organization
- Identity and access management configuration
- Multi-tenant architecture patterns
- Security policy implementation
- Integration with external systems
- Compliance and audit requirements
